title.zh: 将根据第134号法（经第594号法修正）向安蒂克省与甲米地省提供的各为两千五百美元美国货币贷款的还款日期推迟至1904年12月31日的法案
title.en: AN ACT POSTPONING THE DATE OF PAYMENT OF THE LOANS OF TWO THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS EACH, MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, MADE TO THE PROVINCES OF ANTIQUE AND CAVITE, UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR, AS AMENDED BY ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND NINETY-FOUR, TO DECEMBER THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.orig: AN ACT POSTPONING THE DATE OF PAYMENT OF THE LOANS OF TWO THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS EACH, MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, MADE TO THE PROVINCES OF ANTIQUE AND CAVITE, UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR, AS AMENDED BY ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND NINETY-FOUR, TO DECEMBER THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.vi: Đạo luật hoãn ngày trả nợ các khoản vay hai nghìn năm trăm đô la Mỹ mỗi khoản cho tỉnh Antique và tỉnh Cavite theo quy định của Đạo luật số 134 đã được sửa đổi bởi Đạo luật số 594 đến ngày 31 tháng 12 năm 1904
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเลื่อนกำหนดเวลาการชำระหนี้เงินกู้จำนวนสองพันห้าร้อยดอลลาร์สหรัฐอเมริกาแต่ละรายการที่ให้แก่วิลายะอันตีเกและวิลายะกาบิตีภายใต้บทบัญญัติแห่งพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 134 ซึ่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมโดยพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 594 ไปเป็นวันที่ 31 ธันวาคม พ.ศ. 2447
title.id: Undang-Undang menunda tanggal pembayaran pinjaman masing-masing dua ribu lima ratus dolar Amerika Serikat yang diberikan kepada Provinsi Antique dan Provinsi Cavite berdasarkan ketentuan Undang-Undang Nomor 134 sebagaimana telah diubah oleh Undang-Undang Nomor 594 hingga 31 Desember 1904
title.ms: Akta menangguhkan tarikh pembayaran pinjaman masing-masing dua ribu lima ratus dolar Amerika Syarikat yang diberikan kepada Wilayah Antique dan Wilayah Cavite di bawah ketentuan Akta Nombor 134 yang telah dipinda oleh Akta Nombor 594 sehingga 31 Disember 1904

text.en:
The date of payment to the Insular Treasury of the loans of two thousand five hundred dollars
each, money of the United States, made to the Provinces of Antique and Cavite, under the provisions of Act
Numbered One hundred and thirty-four, as a mended by Act Numbered Five hundred and ninety-four, is
hereby postponed until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and four.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Com mission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 24, 1904.
